items.title: Agent swarm writes 10,000 lines of fused Hopper kernels for up to 38% faster decode
items.summary: SemiAnalysis says @mgoin_ used an agent swarm to write about 10,000 lines of ultra-fused decode kernels for Hopper GPUs, improving decode speed by up to 38%. The point is that older Hopper and Blackwell parts got little of NVIDIA's decode-specialized software, and agent-written kernels are filling that gap.

doubt.pushback: Only an 'up to' figure with no linked benchmark, model or repo in the post; not yet independently reproduced.
